answer: Miscellaneous >> Tasawwuf Question ID: 350 Country: ZA Title: Is gathering of communal loud thikr in the Masaajid permissible? Question: Is gathering of communal loud thikr in the Masaajid permissible? Answer ID: 350 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 16=162/L) If there is none offering salah , and people get involved in loud Zikr individually then it is allowed even it seemingly creates a scene of collective Zikr : وفي حاشیة الحموي للشعراني: قد اجمع العلماء سلفاً و خلفاً علی استحباب ذکر الجماعة في المساجد وغیرھا الا ان یشوش جھرھم علی نائم او مصل او قارئ (شامي: 2/434 ، ط زکریا، دیوبند) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
